title: Comparative Verdict
justification: Factory 90 vs Vanilla 65 (+25). Delta exceeds 15-point threshold. Scores independently derived from actual code artifacts — NOT reused from AB-0.
factory_advantages: Architecture design (+5): explicit design document vs ad-hoc structure
Code correctness (+5): 10+1 tests vs 7, CLASSIFICATION_FIRST policy
Safety (+6): input validation, sort validation, safety annotations
vanilla_advantages: Simpler setup: no Factory install/bootstrap overhead
Faster start: no explicit design phase before coding
limitations: Scores from artifact inspection, not live multi-hour session comparison
